$comment: Dragonspire Frostfall (Paperclip Gaming) demo, re-measure protocol of DESIGN.md s.22. Numbers only: no frames, pixels, assets or text of the reference. Captures stay in the gitignored art/_reference/. "ours" = DESIGN.md s.18.1/s.19 values for comparison; adopt a measured value only if it differs by > 15% and passes ANIMATION_CONTRACT s.9 feel gates.
statusNote: No Dragonspire frames exist yet. The only capture attempt (probe1) got HTTP 400 "session not found" from the RGS authenticate call: the demo sessionID had expired, so the game never left its loading screen. Every reference value is null until a run with a fresh demo URL is analysed.
generator: df-analyse.mjs (study scripts kept outside the repo) on top of tools/reference/timings.mjs

capture.regionSource: fractions of the game canvas read off the user's two stills (ref_dragon_2.png base game, ref_dragon_1.png intro), not verified on a live probe

units: ms of virtual game time (60 fps, frame-exact) unless noted; px converted to a 1920-wide canvas

confidenceScale.low: heuristic on motion energy: confirm on the contact sheets
confidenceScale.medium: direct energy measurement, +-1 frame on every-frame segments

spin.pressToFirstMotion.method: first burst start over grid.c1..c5 energy after the spin input (timings.mjs bursts, capture timeline); RGS answers within 1-2 frames (net-sync), so this is the game's own start latency

fallOut.wholeBoard.method: loss rounds where every column shows two bursts 17..400 ms apart: first burst = old symbols leaving (first start -> last end over the 5 columns); if the game drops without a gap this stays null and must be read off the every-frame sheets

compareAgainst.why: ours re-derived for a 5x5 board (4 column and 4 row gaps): 260 + 35x4 + 15x4; adopt per gap, then re-derive our 6x6 total (DESIGN.md s.22.1 rule 1)

column.stagger.method: median gap between consecutive columnStops (end of each column's first >=150 ms burst), every-frame spins +-1 frame, every-2nd/3rd +-2/3 frames

dropIn.firstMoveToLastSettle.method: split loss rounds: second burst first start -> last end over the 5 columns; otherwise median(last column settleT) - median(first motion), flagged includesFallOut

compareAgainst.why: ours re-derived for a 5x5 board: 950 - one column gap (60) - one row gap (25); staggers are 0 in turbo

land.settleTail.method: timings.mjs landing tail: low-energy motion after the column stop until a >=50 ms quiet gap

land.bouncePeaks.method: local energy maxima inside the landing tail, every-frame spins only; a bounce shows as 1-2 peaks (down and back): confirm on frames

tumble.stepAfterLand.method: (last grid motion - board settle) / number of win events in the round's book; includes win present, explode and refill, so compare with present + explode + refill, not the step row alone

compareAgainst.why: the measurement spans win present + explode + refill: cluster present 1000/500/333 + tumble step 1250/410/275; build = docs/games/bass-drop/README.md measured round timings

meter.reaction.row: Orb flight (meter lag after the first post-land grid burst)
meter.reaction.method: start of the first meter-region burst after the first post-land grid burst (ours = pop-out 90 + flight 520)

compareAgainst.why: our first orb arrival counted from the start of the win presentation: cluster present + explode squeeze 80 + pop-out 90 + flight 520 (+ the 100 ms explode hit-stop in normal only). The "ours" 610 (pop-out + flight) applies only if the frames show the reference has no separate present phase

meter.counterBurst.method: median duration of meter-region bursts after the first post-land grid burst; per-symbol vs per-cluster from burst count vs book clusters/winSymbols (see segments[].meterBursts)

speed.turboOverNormal.method: median(turbo state A) / median(normal) per metric

speed.turboBOverNormal.row: second turbo state ratio (super turbo if the button cycles)
speed.turboBOverNormal.method: median(turbo state B) / median(normal); state B is super turbo only if the df-c turbo-A/B/C shots show 3 states

speed.quickStopOverNormal.method: median(quick) / median(normal); boardSettle ratio < 0.8 means a slam stop exists

ours.model: one orb per winning symbol, counter +1 per orb

meter.perSymbolOrCluster.unit: bursts per cluster / per symbol, x100
meter.perSymbolOrCluster.method: meter-region bursts after the first post-land grid burst divided by clusters and winning symbols in the book; ~100 per cluster = per-cluster increments, ~100 per symbol = per-symbol; rolls merge bursts, so confirm on frames

wild.summon.method: rounds whose book has wild/dragon/multiplier events: longest full-canvas burst after the board settles, plus shake episodes of the static patches; beat-by-beat split read off the frames

miniPanel.activity.row: Mini 5-column panel under the meter (function unknown)
miniPanel.activity.method: mini-region bursts per spin; activity in loss rounds = reacts to every spin (reel/column display), only after wins = win/meter linked; the function itself is read off the frames

intro.cardsOut.method: intro-dismiss segment (every frame): click -> last full-canvas motion; "in" happens during boot in real time and is not measurable frame-exact

idle.loops.method: median spacing of burst starts per region during 30 s of idle

bigWin.tiers.method: segments whose play payout >= DF_BIGWIN x bet: payout multiplier from the RGS body, duration = press -> last full-canvas motion (continue taps after 4 s of stillness). Tier names and thresholds must be read off the frames

bonus.flow.method: whole bought/hunted bonus segment; trigger -> intro -> first spin -> outro split must be read off the every-2nd-frame sheets

shake.peak.method: SAD block match (+-20 px, parabolic sub-pixel) of static patches (stage frame, logo, HUD) against the segment's first frame; episodes = runs of |offset| >= 0.75 px; validated on synthetic shifts (--shake-selftest)

decisions.result: no change: nothing measured, no [RM] row adopted (DESIGN.md s.22.1)
